entries.title: Amos 5:2
segments:
vv 2-3. 
 
When God has forsaken a people or an individual, no earthly help can avail.

entries.title: Amos 5:4
segments:
vv 4-6. 
 
They who in times of calamity resort for deliverance to sinful practices, instead of seeking God's help by repentance and holy obedience, only plunge themselves into speedier and more terrible destruction.

entries.title: Amos 5:5
segments: Beer-sheba; in this city, on the southern border of the holy land, as well as at Beth-el and Gilgal, idolatrous rites were practised.  See

entries.title: Amos 5:7
segments: Turn judgment to wormwood; pervert justice to oppression, as in

. 
 
vv 7-10. 
 
A true apprehension of God's glorious character and attributes, and his supreme control over nature and the course of human affairs, prepares the way for faith in him, and that holiness of heart and life which is inseparable from faith.  But they who are ignorant of God and alienated from him, will give themselves up to worldiness and sin, and hate those who vindicate the cause of truth and righteousness.

entries.title: Amos 5:8
segments: Maketh the seven stars--calleth for the waters; controls the whole course of nature.  Compare

entries.title: Amos 5:9
segments: That strengtheneth--the fortress; rather, "that causeth destruction to shine," like a flash fo lightning, "upon the strong, and destruction cometh upon the fortress."  Compare

entries.title: Amos 5:10
segments:
They; the people of Israel. 
 
  Him that rebuketh in the gate; the upright judge who condemns the wicked.

entries.title: Amos 5:11
segments: They who seek to be rich by spoiling the poor, bring on themselves misery and ruin; God will take part with the weak against their oppressors, and "spoil the soul of those that spoiled them."

entries.title: Amos 5:13
segments:
Shall keep silence; because men will not listen to their words. 
 
When the character and conduct of a people are such that the wise and good feel constrained to keep silence, it is a sign that their ruin is near.

entries.title: Amos 5:14
segments:
vv 14-17. 
 
In all times of trouble, repentance and hearty obedience to God's law are the divinely appointed and sure way of obtaining relief; but for those who reject this way and continue to rebel against God, nothing remains but lamentation and woe.

entries.title: Amos 5:16
segments: The husbandman to mourning; because the fruits of the earth are cut off.  See

entries.title: Amos 5:18
segments: The day of the Lord; the day when God shall interpose in behalf of his people.  Such a day would not bring deliverance to the wicked, but inevitable destruction.  Compare

.  This prophecy was fulfilled in the judgments by which God destroyed the kingdoms of Israel and Judah, and more terribly in those which followed the advent of Christ. 
 
vv 18-20. 
 
When the day of promised deliverance comes to the righteous, it will consume the wicked.  Such was the result of Christ's coming, to the proud and rebellious among the Jews.

entries.title: Amos 5:21
segments:
Smell in your solemn assemblies; or, "smell your solemn assemblies;" the savor of their sacrifices; that is, take delight in them. 
 
vv 21-24. 
 
God will accept no observance of religious rites, though they bethose of his own appointment, in place of a holy hert and a righteous life. Though wicked men multiply ever so much the outward forms of religion, they and their services still remain abominable in his sight.

entries.title: Amos 5:24
segments: Judgment; justice in the administration of law.  if the people will be acceptable to God, they must begin by thorough repentance, and works meet for repentance.  Compare

entries.title: Amos 5:25
segments: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings? that is, have ye offered to me alone, with undivided love and obedience?  The question reproaches them not for omitting sacrifices in the wilderness, of which there is no proof, but for uniting with them their own superstitions. See

. 
 
vv 25-27. 
 
God will not share our service with idols; he will have our undivided love, confidence, and obedience, or reject us as unclean and abominable.

entries.title: Amos 5:26
segments:
Chiun you images; according to some, "the statue of you images." 
 
  The star of your god; probably the planet Saturn, symbolized by a star.

entries.title: Amos 5:27
segments: Will I cause--beyond Damascus; see
.  Assyria lay beyond Damascus.
